title: LAS and DLIS import/export
status: gate met - LAS 2.0/3.0 load and export with the tools' compliance checker, DLIS frames with array-channel warnings, decimation and encoding reported

implementation.tests: test/Beep.OilandGas.Desktop.Tests/LasInteropTests.cs (11), DlisFixture.cs (RP66 v1 fixture ported from the tools' DlisTests)

commands.note: The newly referenced Wellbore.Loaders emits four CA2263 warnings in its own project on a clean compile; none are in a Beep.OilandGas.Desktop path.

gates.AC-1 a LAS 2.0 file loads, assigns curve: pass - the example file loads as 'LAS 2.0' with 2 curves (GR, RHOB), 9 rows, depth index in metres, and the model converts to a drawable WellboreDocument with a GR curve.
gates.AC-2 a LAS 3.0 file passes Las3Checker a: pass - an export as 3.0 passes Las3Checker with zero findings, and A_las_2_file_does_not_pass_the_las_3_checker proves the checker is not vacuous. Structure round-trips: same curve list, row count, index range and values.
gates.AC-3 a DLIS file loads frames as log set: pass - the RP66 v1 fixture has one frame with scalar DEPT/GR and a dimension-3 WAVE channel; the loader produces one log set containing GR and warns 'frame MAIN: array channels not loaded as curves: WAVE'. The fixture is ported from the tools' own DlisTests so it is a real file, not a mock.
gates.AC-4 a decimated load states the ratio: pass - a bounded load returns Decimated true with 'Decimated: 9 source row(s) shown as 4 (2.3:1).'; the smoke run prints the same sentence.
gates.AC-5 encoding is shown and overridable: pass - a detected read reports utf-8; an explicit windows-1252 override is honoured and reported, with the same row count.
gates.AC-6 an export produces a file that relo: pass - export to disk, reload from disk: standard LAS 3.0, same 9 rows, same curve list, values equal; Las3Checker on the written file is empty.

limits: The import is session-only: PPDM persistence is DAT-02, and the page states it.
The curve mapping step (source -> target profile) is not built; LAS mnemonics are used as they arrive.
Only LAS 2.0 and 3.0 are written; DLIS is read-only because the tools ship no writer.
The page was constructed by the smoke run and driven through Example/Import/Export; it was not clicked through in a shown window.
The Wellbore.Loaders project emits four CA2263 warnings of its own on a clean compile; the desktop's projects remain at zero warnings.
